findings.message: the pattern matches 9 of 18 sample lines. It must match every one: a line it misses is dropped entirely, not partly parsed. The first it misses is 'Failed password for invalid user nosuchuser from 172.18.0.22 port 42736 ssh2'. every capture matches; the failure is in the literal text between them It also misses lines of other shapes: 'Failed password for invalid user bob from 172.18.0.22 port 52000 ssh2'; 'Failed password for invalid user admin from 172.18.0.22 port 33644 ssh2'; 'Failed password for invalid user postgres from 172.18.0.22 port 33684 ssh2'. If this line is a VARIANT of the others - an extra word, a field that is sometimes absent - make that part optional with (?:...)? rather than writing a second pattern. If it is a DIFFERENT KIND of message - different words, not one more of them - add a pattern for it to `alternatives`, reusing the same capture name for the same value.
